findings.location: Paragraph containing Revelation 13:16-17 (around: "And he causeth all, both small and great...")
findings.source_quote: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name –Revelation 13:16-17.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted Scripture into Italian and use the conventional Italian book name. Example replacement text (preserving the same surrounding HTML/emphasis): «E fece sì che tutti, i piccoli e i grandi, i ricchi e i poveri, i liberi e i servi, ricevessero un marchio sulla mano destra o sulla fronte; e che nessuno potesse comprare o vendere, se non colui che avesse il marchio, o il nome della bestia, o il numero del suo nome» – Apocalisse 13:16-17.
findings.translation_quote: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name –Revelation 13:16-17.

findings.location: Paragraph with parenthetical citation "–See Matthew 24:21 and Revelation 7:14."
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the English book names with Italian equivalents and translate the cue word. Example: «–Vedi Matteo 24:21 e Apocalisse 7:14.»

findings.location: Paragraph quoting 2 Corinthians 6:17 (around: "Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate...")
findings.source_quote: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you –2 Corinthians 6:17.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the Bible quotation into Italian and use the conventional Italian book name. Example replacement (preserving emphasis/tags): «Perciò, uscite dal loro mezzo e separatevi, dice il Signore, e separatevi dalle cose immunde; e io vi accoglierò» – 2 Corinzi 6:17.
findings.translation_quote: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you –2 Corinthians 6:17.

findings.location: Paragraph referencing Revelation 14:10-11 and quoting Revelation 14:12 (around: "Here is the patience of the saints...")
findings.source_quote: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus –Revelation 14:12.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted verse into Italian and convert the book name. Example: «Qui sta la perseveranza dei santi: ecco quelli che osservano i comandamenti di Dio e la fede di Gesù» – Apocalisse 14:12.
findings.translation_quote: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus –Revelation 14:12.

findings.translation_quote: Revelation 14:10-11 dichiara che tutti coloro che prendono il marchio sigilleranno il loro destino all’inferno.
